title: Critique: strong sensory processing occurs without experience

statements.text: Words missed in the attentional blink, rated as zero visibility, still evoke strong, long-lasting potentials up to 300 ms, a time at which local recurrent loops should be established. Strong and elaborate processing in sensory areas is then not sufficient for subjective experience.

sources.quote: Therefore, strong and elaborate processing within sensory areas is not sufficient for subjective experience.
